hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */man/*|*/NAMESPACE) echo 'Generated by roxygen2: edit the roxygen comments in R/ and run devtools::document() instead' >&2; exit 2;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.R) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && Rscript -e 'devtools::test(reporter = "summary")' ;; esac
